description: Search across your stored memories under your authenticated Bearer key (agent_id is accepted but not currently used to partition storage — see memory_store's note). Returns matching keys + snippets. Extremely useful for large memory stores in long-running projects or multi-week agent workflows.

agent_id.description: Accepted but not currently used to partition storage — memory is namespaced by your Bearer key.

query.description: Search string (simple contains match on keys + values)

name: memory_search
